scripts.build:libs: npm run build --workspace=@monabid/shared && npm run build --workspace=@monabid/ui
scripts.dev: npm run build:libs && concurrently -n backend,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build --workspace=@monabid/assistant-backend && npm run build --workspace=@monabid/assistant-client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:libs && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:libs && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build --workspace=@monabid/shared && npm run migration:run --workspace=@monabid/assistant-backend
scripts.db:revert: npm run build --workspace=@monabid/shared && npm run migration:revert --workspace=@monabid/assistant-backend
scripts.db:seed: npm run build --workspace=@monabid/shared && npm run seed --workspace=@monabid/assistant-backend
scripts.db:reset: npm run build --workspace=@monabid/shared && npm run reset --workspace=@monabid/assistant-backend
